newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: SAfrica May prov financing figures 5.91 bln rand.
newsitem.headline: SAfrica May prov financing figures 5.91 bln rand.

text.p: Financing of 3,432 million rand was obtained through government bonds while net short-term loans increased by 1,312.9 million rand during May this year, the South African Finance Department said on Tuesday.
In addition, 1,165.4 million rand was received in the Exchequer Account from the proceeds of the sale of a 30 percent stake in Telkom to a strategic equity partner.
Total financing for May amounted to 5,910.3 million rand, the department said in a statement.

* The discount on zero coupon bonds is treated on an accrual basis. The discount is written off over the life of the loan and provided for annually as interest expenditure. At the same time a corresponding amount is added to new loans received by the Exchequer.
Government bonds to the amount of 90.4 million rand were redeemed during April and May 1997, the statement said.
